notes.title: Important News!
notes.notes:
Hi, Ells&Pills is here!
It’s time for another round of discounts, but that’s not the main thing.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/bcbceb81268cb7cd25a0547b86c270bdaa4d14bb.jpg[/img]

Today, we want to share with you information about an interesting indie horror game being created by our friend from Ukraine. This is his debut game — he’s working on it solo under very difficult life circumstances. So, we would really appreciate it if you could visit the game’s Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405860/Lurking_Within/

If the game catches your attention, please add it to your Wishlist! Today, this means a lot and is especially valuable for the creator.

Best Regards, 
Ells&Pills.

notes.title: Announcement of the new Ells Tales!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/542b037f5404605d6f024452d372fa616baa745d.jpg[/img]

After almost a year, we’re excited to announce the upcoming release of the new game [b]Ells Tales[/b], returning to the roots of the series! Missing the separate control of each of the character’s hands and that retro-style graphics?

So, we’re proud to present the new chapter — [b]Ells Tales: Chairbound[/b]. Step into the shoes of a person tied to an office chair in the middle of a gloomy office building. Control the movement and rotation of the chair using physics, but be careful not to tip over, and find your way to escape before time runs out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-wZ11Xy7Zhc

Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the upcoming release:

store.steampowered.com/app/3281410/Ells_Tales_Chairbound

Wishing you a great summer! All the best from the Ells&Pills team!

notes.title: Improving the gaming experience!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]

Don't worry, this update does not add another dose of madness to the game! The update includes:
[list]
[*] The pick up range with the dildo/banana has been increased from 2 to 2.5 meters.
[*] The pick up outline is no longer overlapped by other objects and is now brighter. This will make it easier to find the dildo/banana in the bushes and liquid.
[*] Added 3 additional dildos/bananas to the game location on hardcore mode.
[*] Minor localization fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: New localization? Again?
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]

Don't worry, this update does not add another dose of madness to the game too! This update includes:
[list]
[*] Localization of the game, game page and achievements into Polish.
[*] Ability to invert the Y-axis in the options. We've been asked for this customization since the last game, so now we'll be adding this to every new game.
[*] The game now minimizes correctly when you click on the Publisher's Games button.
[*] Fixed a few minor visual bugs in the game.
[/list]

notes.title: New localization!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]

Don't worry, this update does not add another dose of madness to the game! Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese have been added to the game. In addition, the game's Steam page and achievements have been translated.

notes.title: MAD Update #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]
There are times in life when a utility apocalypse happens! But that doesn't stop a real hater, does it? XD

[b]This mad update includes:[/b]

[list]
[*] New hardcore game mode [b]“Utility Apocalypse”[/b]. Your task is to hit all the pigeons without getting your feet wet. If the game seems too easy, try this!
[*] Two new achievements. One of the achievements is given for completing the game on hardcore mode, the other is available for getting in any mode ( [i]spoiler: it's box-related[/i]).
[*] Correcting the sound attenuation of the goose. Now it can be heard a little better and a little farther away.
[*] Fixed one of the bugs that caused the goose to not react to the player's approach.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would not disappear during a cutscene.
[/list]

We'd also like to point out that no one but the character makes a sound when touching the surface of the liquid, as if it didn't exist. It's not a bug, it's the way it's designed. After all, this is a game in our mad series of games, maybe a little later the character went to the hospital to see a psychiatrist? Who know... 

Please don't take it too seriously, it's just a game. It's exactly what games are for, a similar, sometimes absurd experience. So that you don't have to do something stupid in real life, but have the opportunity to get into some crazy role and blow off steam in the virtual world.

notes.title: MAD Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]
We didn't plan to make updates because this particular joke game is fully represented and doesn't need any additions. But!

It was hard to resist adding a legendary bird familiar to many players! Considering the absurdity of what is happening on the screen, a rude, swearing goose is exactly what is needed, a kind of cherry on the cake! So here's a humble update that adds a legendary bird and one additional achievement!

Please don't take it too seriously, it's just a game. It's exactly what games are for, a similar, sometimes absurd experience. So that you don't have to do something stupid in real life, but have the opportunity to get into some crazy role and blow off steam in the virtual world.

notes.title: The best birthday gift for a friend is available!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]
It was hard to imagine that after a while our game collection would be extended with such an ambiguous joke game, but it happened! XD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215545/f7914644a320450d65274168ef91d3517ef3f8bb.jpg[/img]

Our goal from the very beginning was to create a large collection of completely different games that will give a different gaming experience, but will be part of one big universe of madness. Yes, it will be mostly scary games with different monsters, but we can always give green light to other ideas.

Especially, the question “What game to get a friend for a birthday this time?” - is a perennial headache. So someone will definitely smile from our joke suggestion. Although we understand that not everyone will appreciate this specific humor. Anyway, share your opinion about the game in your reviews and Steam Community! Thank you all so much for being here! <3

The final chapter of the humanoid chicken world will be available soon, and there will also be an announcement of several future games coming out in 2025. Follow us so you don't miss a thing!

notes.title: Fall Announcements Time!
notes.notes:
Hi, it's Ells&Pills!
Sorry if we've made you bored. Creating new games hasn't stopped, but it's hard to do more work than 4 hands allow :(
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/145e82ff3d49c9f5049f7726366a8c3968cadaa2.jpg[/img]
Today we want to present you two new games that will soon be available on Steam:
[list]
[*] [b]Ells Tales: Idols[/b], the final game about the world of humanoid chickens with a quite unusual and strange ending. We've already said that all our games will be different, not just copied. This time you can expect a combination of horror and card game based on the rules of card soccer, with some fun innovations from us! 
If you've played the previous two games, it's time to add this game to your Wishlist! You won't have long to wait!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3234970/Ells_Tales_Idols/

[*] [b]Pigeon Hater[/b], our meme game-collaboration with references to our horror games. If you like to play trash-funny games and have nothing against dark humor, then welcome, now we have such a crazy game in our collection! Add it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3151930/Pigeon_Hater/

[/list]
